The '''''Imperial Designation Manual''''' was a document made available to the personnel of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] assigned to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. The manual listed everyone's designation code and corresponding duties.<ref name="DS" />
